protocol.scope: Five pairs exhaust125fixed domain slots on unchanged original two-taxon models; first/second order is the retained producer order, not accuracy preference. Native namedCalBP fields inherit documented AD1950 source datum; age model identities, controls, missingbounds and signedpoints preserved. Compare deterministic original covers at fixed PPE/geometry/transport after verifying source sample/window/count identities. No original chronology refit, new physical/model runs, probability allocation, independentage/vegetation accuracy, historical-selected-cohort or rawsource redistribution. Paired SE explicitly uncomputed because marginal SE lacks cross-profile count/PPE covariance.

based on IntCal13 calibration curve

Clam command line:
clam('KLOT',depths.file=TRUE,type=4)

Clam settings file:
Settings (square brackets give names of the constants)

Calibration curve: IntCal13.14C
Age-depth model: smooth spline [type=4] with spar = 0.3 [smooth]
Weighted by the calibrated probabilities [wghts=1]
Calculations at 95% confidence ranges [prob=0.95]

Calendar age point estimates for depths based on weighted average of all age-depth curves [est=1]
Calendar scale used: cal BP [BCAD=FALSE] at a resolution of 1 yr [yrsteps]
Ages were calculated every 1 [every] cm [depth], from 473 [dmin] to 805 [dmax] cm 

Goodness-of-fit (-log, lower is better):  7.28 
Any models with age-depth reversals were removed

age_epoch_and_scale_scope: Use only the exact named native calibrated chronology point ages; BP datum AD1950 per official Neotoma manual7.5. Publication year and collection year never reset zeroBP. Source raw negative ages retained as outside these nonnegative windows, not invalid BP dates. No chronology posterior or zero-width certainty inferred from missing bounds.
uncertainty_scope: Deterministic retained-output sensitivity at fixed parameter/physical inputs. Raw sample age bounds remain private unchanged; no age distribution or probability allocation. Paired SE withheld without cross-chronology count/PPE covariance.
publication_scope: Only aggregate derived source-qualified comparisons. Private exact native sample/depth/age/count records and original archives are not redistributed. Existing current public analytical-use and historical/private-source rights scopes remain distinct.
scientific_limits: Five pairs exhaust125fixed domain slots on unchanged original two-taxon models; first/second order is the retained producer order, not accuracy preference. Native namedCalBP fields inherit documented AD1950 source datum; age model identities, controls, missingbounds and signedpoints preserved. Compare deterministic original covers at fixed PPE/geometry/transport after verifying source sample/window/count identities. No original chronology refit, new physical/model runs, probability allocation, independentage/vegetation accuracy, historical-selected-cohort or rawsource redistribution. Paired SE explicitly uncomputed because marginal SE lacks cross-profile count/PPE covariance.
